personal.name: Mohamed Ahmed Hassan
personal.title: Qur'an and Islamic Studies Teacher
personal.summary: I am an experienced Qur’an and Islamic Studies teacher with over two years of experience teaching non-Arabic-speaking Muslims in English. I have worked with several well-established academies, including Makkah Academy, Super Muslim Academy, Ruwaq Al-Quran Academy, Bedaya Academy, and Noor Al-Quran Academy, in addition to providing private lessons. I specialize in teaching Qur’an, Tajweed, Tafsir, and Islamic Studies. My lessons are engaging, structured, and tailored to each student’s level, helping them learn confidently while developing a strong connection with their faith.

teaching.experienceDescription: I have over two years of experience teaching Qur’an and Islamic Studies in English to non-Arabic-speaking Muslims. I have worked with several academies, including Makkah Academy, Super Muslim Academy, Ruwad Al-Quran Academy, Bedaya Academy, and Noor Al-Quran Academy, as well as teaching private students. I have taught a range of subjects, including Qur’an, Noor Al-Bayan, Tajweed, Tafsir in English, Seerah, Hadith, and general Islamic Studies. I have experience working with students of different ages and levels and adapt my teaching style to help each learner understand, progress, and build confidence.
teaching.philosophy: My teaching approach is student-centered, practical, and tailored to each learner’s level, age, and individual needs. I focus on making lessons clear, engaging, and easy to follow while encouraging students to participate actively rather than simply listen. I use a structured approach that combines explanation, practice, repetition, and regular feedback to help students make steady progress. I also create a supportive learning environment where students feel comfortable asking questions and making mistakes. My goal is not only to help students learn the Qur’an and Islamic Studies, but also to develop a deeper understanding and connection with their faith.
